sobre.history_paragraph: We are a company dedicated to the production and commercialisation of fruit, located in the magnificent lands of Demo and on the hillsides of the Douro Valley, in the north of Portugal. Our name, Demodouro, was born from the passion with which we produce our fruit in these unique lands

aboutInfrastructure.subtitle: the taste of quality
aboutInfrastructure.title: our orchards
aboutInfrastructure.description: With our own production distributed across several hectares, our orchards are located in a protected geographical area, between 700 and 900 meters above sea level. They benefit from excellent edaphoclimatic conditions, which give the fruit unique characteristics — such as intense coloration, high sugar content, distinctive flavor, and consistent crispness. Our field technical team promotes specialization in both in-house and contracted production. Our agronomists work closely with growers throughout the year, ensuring quality and precision at every stage of the process

macareineta.name: Reineta Apple
macareineta.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.

macareineta.Embalamento: in plastic bags/bulk and packed in plastic or cardboard boxes.
macareineta.FORMA: rounded and flattened, with irregular contours
macareineta.TEXTURA: firm texture with a floury and slightly juicy touch
macareineta.COR: yellowish-green to golden yellow, sometimes with a pinkish tinge

macafuji.name: Fuji Apple
macafuji.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.

macastarking.name: Starking Apple
macastarking.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.

macastarking.Embalamento: in plastic bags/bulk and packed in plastic or cardboard boxes.
macastarking.TEXTURA: creamy white flesh, fine, firm and crunchy
macastarking.COR: red with streaks, on a yellowish background
macastarking.SABOR: sweet, aromatic (with a hint of pineapple) and slightly acidic

macagranny.name: Granny Smith Apple
macagranny.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
macagranny.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 0ºC and 2ºC.
macagranny.Embalamento: in plastic bags/bulk and packed in plastic or cardboard boxes.
macagranny.COR: bright, intense green, smooth with some white spots (lenticels)
macagranny.SABOR: strongly acidic, with a refreshing touch and a less sweet aftertaste

macabravo.name: Bravo Esmolfe Apple
macabravo.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
macabravo.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 0ºC and 2ºC.
macabravo.Embalamento: in plastic bags/bulk and packed in plastic or cardboard boxes.
macabravo.COR: whitish, may have reddish spots, and be stained and/or streaked with scab in the peduncular cavity
macabravo.SABOR: sweet, very slightly acidic and fragrant

cereja.name: Cherry
cereja.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
cereja.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 2ºC and 4ºC.
cereja.Embalamento: cups and cardboard or plastic boxes.
cereja.TEXTURA: firm, fleshy, juicy pulp with a smooth texture
cereja.SABOR: sweet to sweetish and slightly astringent

castanha.name: Chestnut
castanha.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
castanha.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 2ºC and 7ºC.
castanha.Embalamento: bag or box according to specifications.
castanha.FORMA: flattened where it joins the skin and pointed at the other end
castanha.COR: smooth and shiny, dark brown with coppery highlights
castanha.SABOR: sweet, but may vary depending on the variety
castanha.ACIDEZ: low acidity, high starch and fibre content

morango.name: Strawberry
morango.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
morango.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 0ºC and 2ºC.
morango.Embalamento: bag or box according to specifications.
morango.FORMA: conical or rounded, narrower tip and wider base
morango.ACIDEZ: 0.6 to 1.1% (or g/100g of fruit), with a median value of 0.85%

mirtilo.name: Blueberry
mirtilo.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
mirtilo.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between -0,5ºc a 0º c.
mirtilo.Embalamento: bag or box according to specifications.
mirtilo.FORMA: small, with a five-pointed star-shaped mark on the top
mirtilo.COR: waxy blue when ripe, varying to red depending on the variety

kiwi.name: Kiwi
kiwi.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
kiwi.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between -0,5°C e 0,5°C.
kiwi.Embalamento: bag or box according to specifications.
kiwi.FORMA: oval, varying in size between 5 and 8 cm in length
kiwi.TEXTURA: soft and smooth pulp, with a creamy touch and slight firmness
kiwi.COR: brown and fibrous skin, green or yellow pulp with black seeds
kiwi.SABOR: characteristic taste, between sour and sweet, with a hint of citrus
kiwi.ACIDEZ: slightly acidic, with a pH between 3.31 and 3.44 — varies depending on variety and ripeness

framboesa.name: Raspberry
framboesa.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
framboesa.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 0°C e 2°C.
framboesa.Embalamento: bag or box according to specifications.
framboesa.FORMA: multiple fruit (pluridrupa), composed of small druplets, and hollow in the centre (unlike blackberries)
framboesa.TEXTURA: soft, delicate and juicy. It is a soft fruit, with small druplets that detach easily, making it fragile and without a lignified skin
framboesa.COR: varia de rosa (para longas distâncias), vermelho vivo, até preto (framboesa silvestre), com variedades amarelas também existentes
framboesa.SABOR: predominantly sweet and slightly acidic (sweet and sour), with a complex and refreshing aromatic profile

uva.name: Grape
uva.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
uva.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 0°C e 1°C.
uva.Embalamento: bag or box according to specifications.
uva.FORMA: round or oval in conical clusters, with variable size and density
uva.CALIBRE: large, uniform berries, with an ideal calibre of 18 mm (seedless) or 24 mm (seeded)
uva.TEXTURA: firm and crunchy pulp, surrounded by a thin skin
uva.COR: red grapes, ranging from green to purple; white grapes, ranging from green to greenish-yellow–depending on ripeness
uva.SABOR: sweet and balanced flavour, with low acidity — can be neutral, special or muscatel, depending on the variety
uva.ACIDEZ: variable acidity depending on variety and ripeness, with pH generally between 4 and 4.5

laranja.name: Orange
laranja.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
laranja.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 2°C e 10°C.
laranja.Embalamento: bag or box according to specifications.
laranja.FORMA: round or ovoid, with variations such as a prominent navel and thin or thick skin
laranja.TEXTURA: juicy and soft pulp, with a refreshing texture
laranja.COR: bright, grainy orange skin; yellowish-orange pulp in common varieties or red in blood oranges
laranja.SABOR: balanced between sweet and sour, depending on the variety and ripeness
laranja.ACIDEZ: variable acidity; fresh juice has an average pH of 4.34

limao.name: Lemon
limao.Armazenamento: in a controlled atmosphere or at normal cold temperatures.
limao.Transporte: in refrigerated vehicles at temperatures between 10°C e 14°C.
limao.Embalamento: bag or box according to specifications.
limao.FORMA: oval or rounded, elongated, ending in two prominent points at the end
limao.TEXTURA: juicy pulp that yields to the touch, indicating ripeness and juice content
limao.COR: green to intense yellow; the more yellow, the riper; green reflections indicate higher acidity
limao.ACIDEZ: intense acidity, with 5% to 7% citric acid and pH between 2.2 and 2.4

aboutHistory.subtitle: OUR HISTORY
aboutHistory.title: It’s tasty because it’s ours
aboutHistory.description:
We are a company dedicated to the production and commercialisation of fruit, located in the magnificent lands of Demo and on the hillsides of the Douro Valley, in the north of Portugal. Our name, Demodouro, was born from the passion with which we produce our fruit in these unique lands.

 Apples and cherries are the products that set us apart, with apples being our main product.

 Our commitment to quality is evident at every step of the process, from cultivation to delivery. We work in close partnership with local and regional producers, ensuring the origin and freshness of the fruit that reaches you.
